title: Nav Node (Flat)
description: Flat navigation node. parent_id is plain text (the parent's node_id, not a reference); the component's all_nodes pool holds every node and the connector rebuilds the tree in code, so menu depth never hits the include-depth cap.

field_metadata.instruction: Display label shown in the menu (e.g. "Power Drills"). For SAP leaf categories that had no title, seed this from the linked link's name.
Stable, unique id for THIS node (e.g. the SAP node uid). Children reference it via Parent Id.
Node Id of the parent node. Leave EMPTY for a top-level item. Plain text on purpose (not a reference) so building the tree costs zero reference-resolution depth.
The clickable link leaf under this node. The only reference in the model — one hop, always resolves. Heading nodes leave this empty.
